verdict.rationale: The docs say dots runs in the cloud with its own computer, can reach local files and code, can run builds with developer tools, and can delegate to Codex or ChatGPT Work. That implies it can write and run code, but nothing documents running code on user data to produce analysis. Missing for 10: explicit data-analysis or code-execution-on-data capability, chart generation, computed-answer workflows, downloadable file outputs, and any hands-on corroboration.
